maddeler.e:
نحتكم (form VIII)
# نَحْتَكِمُ (naḥtakimu) /naħ.ta.ki.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
# نَحْتَكِمَ (naḥtakima) /naħ.ta.ki.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
# نَحْتَكِمْ (naḥtakim) /naħ.ta.kim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
